result:
Compiled successfully on the first attempt.

`tests/org/apache/commons/lang3/math/NumberUtilsAgentTest.java` covers `NumberUtils`'s full documented contract: all 21 reusable constant fields, the four deprecated numeric `compare` overloads, `createBigDecimal`/`createBigInteger`/`createDouble`/`createFloat`/`createInteger`/`createLong`/`createNumber` (null handling, hex/octal parsing, type qualifiers, and `NumberFormatException` on invalid/untrimmed input), `isCreatable`/`isNumber`/`isDigits`/`isParsable` (null/empty/blank cases, the documented `"09"` octal edge case, scientific notation, `NaN`/`Infinity`), all 24 `max`/`min` overloads (array and three-value, across byte/short/int/long/float/double, including `NullPointerException`/`IllegalArgumentException` on null/empty arrays and NaN propagation for the float/double three-value forms), the `toByte`/`toDouble`/`toFloat`/`toInt`/`toLong`/`toShort` default-and-fallback conversions, and all 8 `toScaledBigDecimal` overloads (null→`BigDecimal.ZERO`, default `HALF_EVEN` scale-2 rounding, and custom scale/rounding mode).
